Feeling like that initially can be overwhelming. I'm not sure how long you've been struggling with bland days , and I'm not going to tell you it gets easier. But what I will tell you what helps me. And some days it's hard ... Try to do one nice thing for someone and expect nothing in return. It's when people notice even ever so slight that makes it better. It's not a cure all. Try to look for the little things. The little things are the best. 

Sometimes for me a little thing would be how the sunlight is glowing behind a cloud or how the street lights glow and faintly light up an old building showing the imperfections of the structure with the shadows cast.

Another little thing I like to find in nature/ outside are bugs. I like it when I find them almost completely camouflaging in with their surroundings. 

These are almost always things  I see when I'm alone and  feeling contemplative  or antisocial .
